test_fraction_definition: Observed passed tests divided by 1978 expected tests; includes partial evaluation and is not an official completed-evaluation three-run score.
cost_scope: Observed completed-response usage; summaries included once. Historical API equivalent, not subscription charges, current pricing or server costs.
time_scope: Solver container time only; excludes setup, evaluation and waiting.
comparison_scope: Historical pilot using different runtime builds; not a controlled same-build A/B experiment.
